scenario: a misunderstanding or problem involving workplace everyday communication
english_title: Recognising and Responding to a Misunderstanding or Problem Involving Workplace Everyday Communication
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: workplace everyday communication — a misunderstanding or problem involving workplace everyday communication
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to a misunderstanding or problem involving workplace everyday communication; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Lan apologises to Ms Grace for being confused about a deadline.
context_note_vi: Chị Lan xin lỗi chị Grace vì không hiểu rõ hạn chót.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Grace, I am sorry. I am confused about this deadline.
turns.vietnamese: Grace này, xin lỗi chị. Tôi không hiểu rõ hạn chót này lắm.

turns.speaker: Ms Grace
turns.english: No problem. Let me clarify it for you.
turns.vietnamese: Không sao đâu. Để tôi giải thích rõ cho chị.
